title: Local News Shrunk To 4,490 Newspapers
closing: Without local reporting, decisions affecting your taxes and schools receive less scrutiny.
question: Who still reports on your town?

segments.say: Local news shrank to 4,490 newspapers. Thousands of communities lost reporting capacity.
Local news deserts reached 208 counties. Those communities have no dedicated source watching local institutions.
Local news is scarce for 15 percent of Americans. Millions now miss routine scrutiny of local decisions.
